title: OCR: headline and highlighted text
prompt: Transcribe exactly the headline of this image and the time frame highlighted in color.
reference: Headline: "When will I get my refund?". Highlighted (orange/red) time frame: "within 10 - 21 days".

values: When will I get my refund

title: Layout: numbered steps in order
prompt: The image contains numbered steps. List every step number with its heading, in order.
reference: 1. When to check...  2. What you need...  3. How...

title: Visual Q&A across panels
prompt: According to the image, which three pieces of information do I need, and how long after mailing a paper return should I check?
reference: Social Security Number, filing status, exact refund amount. Check 4 weeks after mailing a paper return.

title: Hallucination trap: absent phone number
prompt: What toll-free phone number does this image tell me to call?
reference: No phone number appears in the image. It actually says NOT to call the toll-free number unless Where's My Refund says so.

title: Document page: small print
prompt: From this page: what is the catalog number, what date is printed at the bottom left, and what is the deadline to furnish statements to individuals?
reference: Catalog Number 63016Q; date at bottom left: Oct 29, 2026; deadline: on or before January 31, 2027 (for coverage in calendar year 2026).

title: Two-column reading order
prompt: This page has two columns. List, in reading order, the headings and subheadings of the LEFT column only.
reference: Future Developments; Additional Information; General Instructions; Purpose of Form; Who Must File; When To File; How To File.

title: Document page: details lookup
prompt: What is the estimated average time for preparing the form, and to which postal address can comments be sent?
reference: Preparing the form: 3 min. Address: Internal Revenue Service, Tax Forms and Publications, 1111 Constitution Ave. NW, IR-6526, Washington, DC 20224.

title: Accessibility description
prompt: Describe this image for a visually impaired person in 3 to 4 sentences: what it is, who published it, and the key information it conveys.
reference: An IRS informational graphic titled "When will I get my refund?" (IRS logo top left). It says e-filers can generally expect refunds within 10-21 days and asks not to call the toll-free number unless Where's My Refund says so. Three numbered blue panels: when to check (72 hours after e-filing, 4 weeks after mailing a paper return), what you need (SSN, filing status, exact refund amount), and how (go to Where's My Refund).
